rows.claim: Exact OpenMW source pin and Lua API revision are machine-readable and enforced
Content-addressed source cache rejects absence, tampering, and the wrong Git commit
Offline bootstrap materializes only verified pristine source without network access
Ordered exact-pin OpenMW patches and new-file overlays are generated, applied, verified, and audited against per-path provenance, tests, base blobs, and result hashes
Strict local v1 schemas, classified fixtures, deterministic manifests, structural validation, and loopback contract abuse cases pass
Clearly named fixture ZIP/TAR archives are normalized and deterministic with content/release/source manifests, SHA256SUMS, SPDX 2.3 SBOM, package linkage, and ownership dry-runs
Fail-closed clean and canary tests cover archive safety, GPL/notices/source inputs, provenance, secrets, proprietary data/media, privacy, SBOM coverage, suppressions, and reproducibility
Release-named runtime/Lua/source set has exact corresponding source, notices, complete provenance, rebuild evidence and clean product audits
rows.resume_when: Built ALMSIVI runtime and Lua product files, exact pinned OpenMW source materialization manifest, authoritative patch manifest, dependency locks/licenses/notices, and clean rebuild evidence exist

rows.claim: Unmodified exact-pin OpenMW control configures and builds on target platforms
Protocol fixtures and validators pass against final ALMSIVIserver
rows.resume_when: Final server import and cross-repository task are authorized

rows.claim: Exact-pin Windows x64 control and product builds pass
rows.resume_when: Run on a Windows VS 2022 host with OpenMW dependencies pinned by the upstream source

rows.claim: Windows in-game behavior passes with legal Morrowind GOTY data
rows.resume_when: User supplies legal game data and an exact package/profile acceptance environment
